traditional: the Sun sextile Jupiter: a soft contact. Vitality, authority, and recognition supports growth, fortune, and patronage — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Identity meets optimism, expansion, and luck. Confidence to venture and a sense that the odds will cooperate. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Genuine confidence and opportunity; doors open more readily. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize selfhood and growth into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what selfhood and growth have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Confidence and opportunity, with overextension as the standing risk.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and excess and overreach go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: A grant clears and a partner signs, funding the exact piece that needed support right as momentum stalled. Someone uses the opening to hire the missing person, reserve the space, or secure the permit before the money is redirected. The Sun keeps the expansion anchored to its original purpose, while Jupiter brings a bigger audience, budget, and level of institutional confidence. The sextile opens a larger door, but the opportunity still depends on someone moving before the window closes. The project grows because the new support is attached to a specific need instead of a bigger promise.
